title: Can Birdsong Make You Happier?
summary: Олон төрлийн шувууны дуу сонсох нь хүнийг илүү аз жаргалтай болгож магадгүй.

source.name: VOA Learning English
source.creditLine: Anna Matteo wrote this story for VOA Learning English. Susan Shand was the editor.

changes: Program intro, headings, sign-off, credit line, quiz link and the Words in This Story list removed.

questions.prompt: What is the main idea of the text?
options: Hearing many kinds of birds may make us happier
Birds in big cities sing more loudly than wild birds
Birds sing more when people are happy and relaxed
questions.explain: Эхэнд нь "hearing diverse birdsongs may help increase our happiness" гэж гол санааг хэлсэн.

questions.prompt: Why did the Cal Poly team do the study in the summer?
options: To avoid disturbing birds in breeding season
There are more hikers on the trails in summer
Birds sing more loudly in the summer months
questions.explain: Хавар бол шувуудын үржлийн улирал учраас "We didn’t want to disturb the birds too much" гэж Ферраро тайлбарласан.

questions.prompt: What does Ferraro suggest people plant?
questions.explain: Тэр "I would recommend planting native trees and flowers" гэж хэлсэн. Тухайн нутгийн ургамлыг л шувууд ашиглаж чаддаг.
